design_rules: Shell/navigation are authorization-safe projections, not authority sources.
Authorization and visibility filtering precede counts/search/ranking/badges/notification aggregation.
Spoiler Shield is UX only and cannot reveal protected cardinality or substitute for security.
Context switches re-evaluate protected projections and assistance scope.
Notification attention is noncoercive and owning-domain backed.
implementation_boundary: Design/planning only. APW-I identifiers remain nonactive until APW-08 final handoff and roadmap activation.
